title: Frontend updates for three-step admin verification UX, secrecy handling, and protected admin routes

requirements.summary: Ensure admin verification codes are never exposed in the frontend (no plaintext constants, logs, or error-message leaks).
acceptanceCriteria: No UI text, client-side constants, network responses, or console logs expose any of the plaintext codes.
Backend error messages returned to the frontend do not contain any code values.

file_operations.description: Harden error handling so the UI never displays raw backend error strings (or any thrown messages) that could contain sensitive details; show generic, user-safe failure messages for step verification and master override verification.

Ensure all admin verification mutations throw and surface only generic, non-sensitive error messages (do not propagate raw backend trap strings), and avoid any console logging around verification failures.
Confirm toast messaging remains generic on failure and does not incorporate backend-provided error strings; ensure no logging includes user-entered codes.
On logout/clear, also clear any cached admin verification progress from sessionStorage to reduce risk of stale state; ensure no logs include any verification-code related values.

Remove/rename legacy helper exports if they are no longer needed by current UI flows, and ensure only step progress (0-3) is stored—no code values or sensitive artifacts are ever written to sessionStorage.

requirements.summary: Keep all /admin routes gated by the admin verification session so admin content never renders publicly.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting any /admin route without a valid admin verification session shows the verification gate and does not render admin content.
Non-admin public website features remain accessible as before.

file_operations.description: Ensure the admin layout wraps all admin content with the AdminRouteGuard so every nested /admin route is consistently gated before rendering any admin UI.
Tighten guard behavior to avoid any admin-content flash during loading/error states, and ensure the verification gate is the only render path when there is no valid admin verification session.
Confirm all /admin routes are nested under the guarded AdminLayout route and that there are no unguarded admin routes/components mounted outside the /admin tree.
Keep the Admin navigation link non-public by continuing to show it only for authenticated users; ensure link visibility logic does not unintentionally reveal admin access to locked-out users.

requirements.summary: Update admin verification UI copy and flows to reflect the three-step sequence (1/3, 2/3, 3/3) and master override usage for code rotation, with no references to retired auth systems.
acceptanceCriteria: The admin gate screen clearly indicates Step 1/3, Step 2/3, Step 3/3 with ordered progression.
The Verification Code Management page continues to require the Master Override Code before allowing code rotation.
No user-facing text instructs users to use any old/previous admin authentication mechanism.

file_operations.description: Update UX copy to clearly describe the ordered three-step progression (Step 1/3 → Step 2/3 → Step 3/3) and clarify the Master Override Code path without referencing any prior/retired admin authentication method.

Change the master override verification UX so it actually verifies the Master Override Code via the existing backend capability before unlocking code rotation fields; update page copy to explicitly state the Master Override Code is required to rotate Code #1/#2/#3.

Ensure the rotation flow messaging aligns with the updated verification UX (master override must be verified first) and that success messaging correctly indicates admin verification sessions are cleared after rotation.
